reviews.Author: Scott Phillips
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on December 10, 2014
reviews.Text: I like a big coarse grained salt to finish meats and certain vegetables- Maldon comes to mind. This salt is great for me as the flakes are, dare I saw, preposterously large. This may be a turn off for some people who don't like big hunks of salt on their food, its not for the faint of heart. The flavor is pretty good- not as refined as a super expensive sel gris or anything but still quite good.

reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on March 24, 2015
reviews.Text: I like this salt and love the taste of it. The only problem is that I thought it would me more soft and flakey. I actually have to crush it. It was a little rocky and rough. Other than that it is good salt.
